abilities.desc_zh:
护盾状态下，录音机对远程攻击拥有不可阻挡的状态  // 打中只吃伤害无受创硬直，类似汽车大师的不可阻挡，但是身上不带光圈
护盾额外提供20%的伤害减免
abilities.desc_en:
Absorption Shield
Blaster’s Shielding system can be upgraded to absorb incoming energy attacks and repair damage. A similar upgrade was requested by his fellow Autobots for their audio receptors as an answer to his taste in music.
While Shielded: Blaster’s Shield allows him to shrug off the impact of Basic Energy Ranged Attacks and reduces a further {{var_13}} of incoming Energy Damage. Additionally Energy Attacks that hit Blaster while his Shielding is up have a {{var_14}} chance to instantly Repair Blaster for {{var_15}} of the opponent’s Attack Rating. If the attack is a Special Attack he repairs double that amount instead.
+ about {{var_16}} per level
Amped - Turn up the volume, start the beats.

abilities.desc_zh: Blaster 获得最多 3 个额外的 Amp Charges。
abilities.desc_en: Blaster gains up to 3 additional Amp Charges.

abilities.desc_en: {{var_17}} chance to grant a Power Gain Buff, generating {{var_18}} of Max Power over {{var_19}}.
Enemies – Soundwave, Tantrum, Cyclonus - +{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} Attack Rating.

abilities.title_zh: 护盾放大器 – 声波、幻影、犀牛
abilities.desc_en: Shield Amp – Soundwave, Mirage, Rhinox - {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} Damage Reduction while Shielded.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲击波在战斗开始时和每次 {{var_35}} 时产生 {{var_34}}~3 能量球。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Shockwave - Shockwave generates {{var_34}}~3 Energy Charges at the start of the fight and every {{var_35}}.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} 增加对拆除机器人的攻击。只有当团队中的所有机器人都具有这种协同羁绊时，Shockwave 才能获得此优势。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Gain – Shockwave - {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} Increase to Attack against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only gets this benefit if all bots on his team have this synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_38}} 所有较低级别队友的功率率。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_38}} Power Rate for all lower tier teammates.

abilities.desc_zh:
发动任意特殊技时，获得1层放大充能，最多叠加10层。//无倒计时
每层放大充能增加6%的远程伤害，包括普通远程，重击和特殊技中的远程攻击
普通远程攻击命中或被防时，有80%概率施加干扰减益，降低对手远程攻击20%的伤害，50%的射速，持续10秒。//最大1层，可刷新

重击命中100%的概率施加震击，造成攻击30%的伤害，持续5秒。
每层放大充能增加20%的震击伤害
abilities.desc_en: (+v8.0) Each hit has a {{var_8}} chance to inflict an Armor Break, removing enemy Armor and applying {{var_9}} Armor reduction for {{var_10}}.

abilities.desc_zh:
进入防御姿态时得到一个护盾，护盾生效时使受到的伤害降低15%，松开防御后0.5秒后护盾消失，每个放大充能延长倒计时0.25秒。

//用例，10个放大充能，松开防御后倒计时为0.25*10+0.5=3秒
abilities.desc_en:
Sonic Shield
Soundwave projects a Sonic Shield that grants him Energy Resistance and a chance to Reflect incoming Ranged Attacks.
When filling a Power Bar: Soundwave projects a Sonic Shield that grants him {{var_5}} Energy Resistance and has a {{var_6}} chance to Reflect incoming Ranged Attacks, dealing {{var_7}} of their original damage.
+about {{var_8}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 护盾状态下，受到远程攻击和远程重击时，有40%的概率立即修复对手攻击力17%的生命值。如果受到的是特殊攻击，则修复34%。
降低对方远程伤害与射速
abilities.desc_en: Dazes the opponent, causing their basic and special ranged attacks to miss.

abilities.desc_zh: 展开力场吸收来袭伤害，优先于生命值消耗。
abilities.desc_en: Deploys a forcefield that absorbs incoming damage before reducing health.
